name: Three neural networks
summary: This EA employs three separate neural networks to generate trading signals, likely combining their outputs through an ensemble or voting mechanism to make buy/sell decisions. Each neural network may be trained on different input features or timeframes to provide diversified signal perspectives. The final trade execution depends on the consensus or weighted aggregation of the three network outputs.
summary_zh: 该EA使用三个独立的神经网络来生成交易信号，可能通过集成或投票机制组合它们的输出来做出买卖决策。每个神经网络可能基于不同的输入特征或时间周期进行训练，以提供多样化的信号视角。最终的交易执行取决于三个网络输出的共识或加权聚合结果。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于三个神经网络的集成学习方法进行交易决策，每个神经网络可能负责分析不同的市场特征维度（如趋势、动量、波动率）。入场条件通常由三个网络的输出信号共同决定，可能采用多数投票制或加权平均制，当两个或三个网络同时发出同方向信号时触发交易。出场条件可能包括反向信号出现、固定止盈止损、或神经网络置信度下降时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA可能根据网络输出的置信度来调整仓位大小，高置信度时加大仓位，低置信度时减少仓位。资金管理方面，集成多个网络本身是一种风险分散手段，但若缺乏独立止损机制和最大回撤控制，仍可能在极端行情中遭受重大损失。该策略的创新之处在于将多神经网络集成应用于金融交易，但过度拟合历史数据是神经网络策略的常见隐患。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is an ensemble learning approach using three neural networks for trading decisions, where each network may be responsible for analyzing different market feature dimensions (e.g., trend, momentum, volatility). Entry conditions are typically determined by the combined output signals of the three networks, possibly using a majority voting or weighted averaging scheme, triggering trades when two or three networks simultaneously emit same-direction signals. Exit conditions may include the appearance of opposing signals, fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or closing positions when neural network confidence decreases. Position sizing may be adjusted based on network output confidence levels—increasing position size for high confidence and reducing for low confidence. Money management benefits from the ensemble approach as diversification across multiple networks inherently spreads risk, but without independent stop-loss mechanisms and maximum drawdown controls, significant losses can still occur during extreme market conditions. The innovation lies in applying multi-neural-network ensemble methods to financial trading, though overfitting to historical data is a common pitfall of neural network strategies.

pros: 三网络集成学习提供信号多样性，降低单一模型偏差风险
置信度阈值机制可以过滤低质量信号，减少虚假交易
多个网络从不同角度分析市场，提高了策略的鲁棒性和适应性
可配置各网络权重，灵活调整策略偏好
集成方法天然具有过拟合缓解效果，比单一神经网络更稳定
pros_en: Three-network ensemble provides signal diversity, reducing single-model bias risk
Confidence threshold mechanism filters low-quality signals, reducing false trades
Multiple networks analyze the market from different perspectives, improving strategy robustness and adaptability
Configurable network weights allow flexible adjustment of strategy preferences
Ensemble methods inherently mitigate overfitting, offering more stability than a single neural network
cons: 神经网络在MQL5中实现受限，训练和推理效率较低
缺乏对训练数据窗口的动态调整机制，可能无法适应市场结构变化
过度拟合历史数据的风险较高，特别是当训练样本不足时
三个网络若使用相似输入特征，集成效果可能退化为单一网络
回测表现可能远优于实盘，因神经网络容易学习到历史噪声而非真实规律
cons_en: Neural network implementation in MQL5 is limited, with low training and inference efficiency
Lack of dynamic adjustment for training data windows may prevent adaptation to market structure changes
High risk of overfitting to historical data, especially when training samples are insufficient
If all three networks use similar input features, the ensemble effect may degrade to a single network
Backtest performance may significantly exceed live trading results, as neural networks tend to learn historical noise rather than genuine patterns
improvements: 增加动态再训练机制，定期用最新市场数据更新网络权重以适应市场变化
引入独立的风险管理模块，包括最大回撤限制和动态仓位控制，避免极端亏损
增加输入特征多样性，确保三个网络使用不同类别的指标（趋势类、震荡类、波动率类）作为输入
improvements_en: Add a dynamic retraining mechanism that periodically updates network weights with the latest market data to adapt to changing conditions
Introduce an independent risk management module with maximum drawdown limits and dynamic position sizing to prevent extreme losses
Increase input feature diversity to ensure the three networks use different categories of indicators (trend, oscillator, volatility) as inputs

risk_points: 神经网络过拟合风险——模型可能仅在历史数据上表现良好而在实盘中失效
缺乏市场结构变化检测——当市场从趋势转为震荡时，网络可能持续发出错误信号
MQL5环境下神经网络推理延迟可能导致信号滞后，在快速行情中错过最优入场点
risk_points_en: Neural network overfitting risk—models may perform well only on historical data and fail in live trading
Lack of market regime change detection—networks may persistently emit wrong signals when markets transition from trending to ranging
Neural network inference latency in MQL5 environment may cause signal lag, missing optimal entry points during fast market moves
